title: Echoes of the Past
description: Luke Skywalker tells Rey the story of how he trained his sister, Leia Organa, years ago. Luke began the tutelage of Leia on Ajan Kloss. This was the very same world that Leia had been training Rey -which the Resistance had been using for their base. Luke speaks of Leia's premonition that Ben would die if she finished her journey to become a Jedi.
